expectations.text: Flags that the two invited keynote speakers never filled in the CFP form, so the bundled checkbox does not cover them, and requires the terms be presented and the answer recorded at acceptance instead
expectations.evidence: 'It never reached the 2 keynotes. They were invited and never saw the form. They need the same terms presented and recorded from scratch.'

expectations.text: Separates recording, live streaming, and publication or channels into distinct consent questions rather than one combined yes/no
expectations.evidence: The table has separate Recording, Live stream and YouTube columns; 'Recording, live streaming and YouTube publication are different questions.'

expectations.text: Sets the policy per session format, stating the answer separately for conference talks, lightning talks and keynotes
expectations.evidence: Format table gives separate rows for Talk (14), Lightning (6) and Keynote (2).

expectations.text: Notes that a lightning talk recorded inside one continuous block cannot practically be cut out of the stream, and treats a no-opt-out policy for that format as a legitimate choice rather than an oversight
expectations.evidence: 'Six talks back-to-back in 45 minutes can't be cut out of a continuous camera feed... you can't opt out of recording for lightning talks.'

expectations.text: Requires any format offering no opt-out to say so plainly and in advance, before submission rather than after acceptance
expectations.evidence: It says 'None, stated plainly' and 'If the CFP didn't say this, don't pretend it did', then offers withdrawal after the fact. It never requires disclosure before submission.

expectations.text: Rejects collecting signed releases on the morning of the event as the primary mechanism, and names the cost it carries on the busiest day
expectations.evidence: 'If someone declines at 09:00 you have a booked crew, a gap in the record and a corridor decision.'

expectations.text: States that a camera in the room is not agreement and that speaker silence is not consent
expectations.evidence: Only 'Silence is not consent' is stated. It never says a camera in the room is not agreement.

expectations.text: Specifies a consent record carrying at least speaker and session, session format, where the terms were shown, date of the answer, recording yes/no, live stream yes/no, publication and channels, and any condition the speaker attached

expectations.text: Requires checking the consent record against the published-video list before anything goes public

expectations.text: Recommends granular per-format consent given that employer-restricted material is in play, and names that condition as the reason
expectations.evidence: 'a decision for invited speakers or employer-restricted material moves you up from bundled into submission to granular per-format consent.'
